plugins.name: daviddtechplus
plugins.description: DaviddTech+ in Claude Code, on top of the DaviddTech+ connector from claude.ai: ready routines as slash commands (close check, night check, storm check, watchlist triage, same-bet check, rule journal, DCA check-in, earnings week) and a market weather report with storm levels.

plugins.name: lab-desk
plugins.description: The Lab desk, read-only: a live Hyperliquid chart your AI can see and paint on, a history lab on years of data (what happened after, moments like now, an honest test with fees, funding and a luck check, the Swarm that tries up to 200 rules at once), your TradingView alerts with a live scorecard, your own trades on the chart from a public address read on your PC with a review of the leaks and a second look against your own rules, a watchlist above the prompt, price and funding in the status line, and the DaviddTech+ forecast range. No keys, no orders.

plugins.name: daviddtech-charts
plugins.description: DaviddTech+ charts in Claude Code: the last forecast (fan, level odds, plan odds, scan ranges) drawn in a pane beside the chat, with a short line above the prompt and /daviddtech-chart.

plugins.name: daviddtech-looks
plugins.description: Animated looks for the Claude desktop and mobile apps: a winter night with snow and lights, a market weather sky that follows the DaviddTech+ storm levels, and a pine forest that pulses red or green after a DaviddTech Aid check.
